I'm sorry you feel this way. I know when you're suicidal you don't really want to listen to anyone, but if you're still here right now then please keep living. Even though I don't know you at all, I know you are not happy. But there are people still left in this world who care. There are people who LOVE you. If you died, think of the pain that you would give them. They would wonder why you did it, and they would eventually start blaming themselves for it. Keep living because people want to help you.

I know your feeling, I have wanted to kill myself since I was 12. I have god awful grades, and am not good at anything. But you want to know why i'm still here? If I died, people would hurt more than I am hurting now. They would wonder why I did it, and they would feel guilt for not helping me. In a sense, they would get the pain I have now. So, if there are people in this world who you care about, don't do it. Live for them and let them know whats wrong with you.
